name: End of Day Procedure
query:
SELECT '
Total Sales
' AS Label, CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) ), 2), '
') AS `Value` UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Payments
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM `tabPayment Entry` AS pe WHERE pe.docstatus = 1 AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive' AND (pe.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (pe.party IN (SELECT name FROM `tabCustomer` WHERE territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, territory)))), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Activity
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(( (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) ) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM `tabPayment Entry` AS pe WHERE pe.docstatus = 1 AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive' AND (pe.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (pe.party IN (SELECT name FROM `tabCustomer` WHERE territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, territory))) ) ), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Credit Sales
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND si.paid_amount = 0 AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory))), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Partially Unpaid Amount
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total - paid_amount), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND si.paid_amount > 0 AND si.paid_amount < si.grand_total AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory))), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Payouts
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(jea.debit - jea.credit), 0) FROM `tabJournal Entry` AS je JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` AS jea ON je.name = jea.parent WHERE je.docstatus = 1 AND (je.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND jea.account = COALESCE(%(account)s, jea.account)), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Available For Deposit
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(( ( (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) ) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM `tabPayment Entry` AS pe WHERE pe.docstatus = 1 AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive' AND (pe.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (pe.party IN (SELECT name FROM `tabCustomer` WHERE territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, territory))) ) ) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND si.paid_amount = 0 AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) ) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total - paid_amount), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND si.paid_amount > 0 AND si.paid_amount < si.grand_total AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) ) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(jea.debit - jea.credit), 0) FROM `tabJournal Entry` AS je JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` AS jea ON je.name = jea.parent WHERE je.docstatus = 1 AND (je.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND jea.account = COALESCE(%(account)s, jea.account)) ), 2), '
') -- Section separator before Credit Sales Listing UNION ALL SELECT '
', '
' UNION ALL SELECT '
Credit Sales Listing
', '
' -- Credit Sales Listing - Customer-wise breakdown UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('
', customer_name, '
'), CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(total_credit_sales, 2), '
') FROM ( SELECT si.customer_name, SUM(si.grand_total) as total_credit_sales FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND si.paid_amount = 0 AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory)) GROUP BY si.customer_name ORDER BY total_credit_sales DESC ) AS credit_sales -- Section separator after Credit Sales Listing UNION ALL SELECT '
', '
' -- Payments Collected Section UNION ALL SELECT '
Payments Collected
', '
' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('
', t.party_name, '
'), CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(t.total_paid, 2), '
') FROM ( SELECT pe.party_name, SUM(pe.paid_amount) AS total_paid FROM `tabPayment Entry` AS pe WHERE pe.docstatus = 1 AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive' AND (pe.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (pe.party IN (SELECT name FROM `tabCustomer` WHERE territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, territory))) GROUP BY pe.party_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC ) AS t -- Section separator after Payments Collected UNION ALL SELECT '
', '
' UNION ALL SELECT '
Discount Amount
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(discount_amount), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory))), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Returns
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.is_return = 1 AND (si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31')) AND (si.territory = COALESCE(%(territory)s, si.territory))), 2), '
') -- Add the new rows here UNION ALL SELECT '
Oversold Total
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (item.price_list_rate - item.rate) < 0 THEN (item.price_list_rate - item.rate) * item.qty ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` AS item INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` AS invoice ON item.parent = invoice.name WHERE invoice.docstatus = 1 AND invoice.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND invoice.territory = %(territory)s ), 2), '
') UNION ALL SELECT '
Under Sold
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (item.price_list_rate - item.rate) > 0 THEN (item.price_list_rate - item.rate) * item.qty ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` AS item INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` AS invoice ON item.parent = invoice.name WHERE invoice.docstatus = 1 AND invoice.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND invoice.territory = %(territory)s ), 2), '
');
